title: Benefits Paid in Error and Their Reversal
content:
# Benefits Paid in Error and Their Reversal — Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda

This claims audit standard of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda governs the reversal of a GAP benefit line that should not have been paid.

## Retired clauses

- *"A benefit is paid in error when the primary insurer reopens or withdraws its total-loss settlement, or a stolen vehicle is recovered before the insurer settles."* — **no longer in force** as written for a paid GAP balance line reversed under the current add-on overpayment rule; every other benefit is paid in error when the primary insurer reopens or withdraws its total-loss settlement, or a stolen vehicle is recovered before the insurer settles.
- *"A benefit paid in error is reversed in full by one reversal entry pointing at the paid line."* — **no longer in force** as written for a paid GAP balance line reversed under the current add-on overpayment rule; every other benefit paid in error is reversed in full by one reversal entry pointing at the paid line.

## Clauses in force

1. **Once only.** A benefit line is reversed at most once. Whether a line has already been reversed is read from the waiver's ledger: a reversal entry pointing at that paid line means it has been.
2. **No reopening.** A reversal does not reopen the waiver; a settled waiver stays settled.

## Reading the standard

| Situation on the ledger | Effect |
|---|---|
| Paid line with no reversal entry pointing at it | the line may be reversed |
| Paid line already carrying a reversal entry | the line is not reversed again |
| Waiver settled before the reversal | still settled after it |

*Hypothetical case:* the insurer withdraws a total-loss settlement after a GAP balance line of 6,214.90 was paid; that line is paid in error and is reversed in full, 6,214.90, by one reversal entry pointing at it, and the waiver's status does not change.

superseded_clauses: A benefit is paid in error when the primary insurer reopens or withdraws its total-loss settlement, or a stolen vehicle is recovered before the insurer settles.
A benefit paid in error is reversed in full by one gap_benefit_reversed entry pointing at the paid line
